name: Moldtelecom Data City
notes: Data City is Moldtelecom's Tier 3-standard colocation/hosting data center at bd. Alba Iulia 77, Chisinau; powered by three independent power sources per operator marketing; ~220 m2 total (2021 tv8.md report). PeeringDB facility 15521 (MD-IX local exchange hosted). Expansion: open tender (offers until 19.09.2024) for capital-repair/consolidation works to extend Data City (moldtelecom.md licitatii/1444, logos-pres.md) - indicates active expansion in Chisinau. capacity_mw null; no reliable MW published.

name: MoldData Cloud (Host.md)
notes: MoldData Cloud data center at Armeneasca St 37/1, Chisinau; colocation and dedicated servers; Tier III data center per Plesk partner directory; DataCenterMap lists 0.5 MW (directory claim, treat as B-/C+ until operator spec sheet). S.E. MoldData is also .md ccTLD registry operator. capacity_mw null per methodology (no operator-published MW).

name: Trabia Network data center / KIVIX
notes: Trabia operates its own data center at Vlaicu Pircalab St 52, Chisinau (MD-2012) and KIVIX, described as Chisinau's second-largest Internet Exchange (operator page). PeeringDB facility 1425 with 11 networks/2 local exchanges confirms active interconnection. Hostsearch directory claims 'largest server farm in Moldova' (C-grade claim, unverified). capacity_mw null.

name: AlexHost colocation data center
notes: AlexHost operates its own data center in Chisinau at C. Brancusi nr. 3; colocation services with autonomous power, cooling/ventilation, video surveillance (operator colocation page). DataCenterMap lists 1.6 MW (directory claim, B-/C+). Hosting business since 2008, own network AS200019. capacity_mw null per methodology.

name: IP HOST Data Center (Inovare-Prim SRL)
notes: IP HOST offers colocation services from its data center in Chisinau; legal entity Inovare-Prim SRL (IDNO 1012600021272), registered in Chisinau municipality. Uzinelor street lead from directories not independently confirmed this pass. capacity_mw null.

name: AvenaCloud data center (Infotech-Grup SRL)
notes: AvenaCloud operates a data center at Str. Muncesti 364, Chisinau, MD-2029 under Infotech-Grup SRL (AS201670). Operator About page describes in-house data center with high security/reliability standards; DataCenterMap lists it as a facility. capacity_mw null; directory claims not treated as authoritative.

name: STISC state data center (existing government DC)
developer: STISC (Serviciul Tehnologia Informatiei si Securitate Cibernetica)
notes: STISC Data Center Infrastructure Service operates the state telecommunication network data center in Chisinau ('the most performant data center in the Republic of Moldova' per STISC page); hosts MCloud government cloud platform services. MCloud itself is a cloud consolidation platform, not a separate new physical facility; not double-counted as new DC.

name: STISC national data center - Centrul de Date TIER III AI-Ready (planned)
developer: STISC / Government of Moldova (with Latvia methodological support)
notes: STISC 2025 activity report references a future national 'Centrul de Date TIER III, AI-Ready' with feasibility-study procurement and land-identification visits to Ungheni district, Falesti district and Balti municipality (site-search stage; no final site public). Latvia confirmed methodological support for the national data center (gov.md; Moldova1/Radio Moldova 13 Jan 2026). Stored as planned/site-search under Chisinau (STISC base) - NOT counted as a project in Balti/Falesti/Ungheni until final site, permit or construction record is public. capacity_mw null.
